## Purpose
Nine ready-made guidance items (8 active, 1 proposed) with conditions and effects, to test the build flow without depending on distillation.

## Settings that matter
- **Each item:** title, body, kind, category, audience, subject, strength, status, conditions, effect.
- **Expected retrieval:**
  - "Task agent for fixed-step extraction" and "Self-check anything with financial impact" match the invoice process;
  - "Conversational agent for dialogue" is filtered out because its condition is false;
  - the proposed item is never used.

## Read by
`test_assets/scripts/smoke_test.py`, which loads them tagged "smoke-test".

None.
